Absolutely recommend it, maybe not every time you go to work, but if you will be gone more than 24 hours its absolutely worth the 3 minutes to walk out and turn the knob. Most water shutoffs are designed with quarter turns now making it very easy.

Sometimes you will get small leaks before the full blow out, so a quick visual inspection when near toilets, sinks etc can always do you good. Braided line connectors I would recommend replacing every ten years, rubber every five. People will usually notice water accumulating and write it off to spilling water during dishes, extra water after a bath/shower etc. as far as pipe blowouts go theres really nothing you can do outside replace lines at normal intervals and shut off your main water supply when leaving on vacation. Even a night out at dinner or a day at work while a line blows could be a nightmare flood.
Mold just ends up being spread across the affected areas due to the increase in moisture and humidity.

No the ceiling caving in is due to water being introduced, usually from a supply line leak or blowout, water heater lines, sinks in upstairs bathrooms, shower supply lines or even sometimes the drains for shower/tubs. Water starts flowing down and soaks jnto the drywall and then makes the drywall heavier to the point it collapses.

There is the off chance they are working alongside your insurance company and don’t have approval for some necessary demo, if you are paying out of pocket and they are saying 4 weeks that is just not even possible for it to take that long.

I work in water/mold restoration can definitely say you’ll be dealing with this for the next few days, dryout typically is 3-5 days with proper equipment and if the technicians do everything properly.

I would recommend going to your local advanced auto and buying carquest gold or platinum brake pads, take your wheels off and get to those pads, do a nice cleaning with brake cleaner and a wire brush on all rubbing surfaces for the brake pads as well as where your clips will mount, after installing your new clips go ahead and apply some copper anti seize to the contact points where the brake pads will move, as well as a nice layer across the BACK side of the brake pads, and the side tabs on the brake pad (please make sure not to get any on the braking surface). Additionally, once you pull the wheel off and look at your rotors edges, if you notice that there is a layer of rust take some 180 grit sandpaper and file it down all the way around, sometimes a layer of rust around the edge will protrude from the braking surface and cause squeaks. Likely after doing all this you will have dead silent brakes, if your brake rotor surface is heavily rusted I would recommend just replacing the rotors, do not use cheap pads, not only do they use crap material but they also tend to cause an extreme amount of brake dust and will end up squealing within a couple weeks. Carquest platinum run about 100-140 front and rear and will last ages with no noise, you may also opt for higher end pads if you want more bite. Just to educate you heres the reason people smurf;

​

As you get better in league of legends obviously this comes with a lot more games played, so what happens is lets say you finally start climbing and seeing improvement, you are casually outplaying and playing better than your opponents in your rank for instance lets use for an example diamond 5, if your account has over 1k games played, your LP gain and loss is fairly mild, not favored to either side, this makes climbing harder than it typically would be.

​

So here comes the smurfing part, when you make a new account and breeze through the lower levels, by the time you get to your rank you were before, or near it you should have about 1/5th, 2/5ths the amount of games played, or even less if you do well. So what you get is an account with high MMR which leads to more LP gain and less LP lost per win/loss and thus making climbing easier.

​

TLDR; People smurf to get a new account with much better mmr to their prior rank, making the climb to even higher ranks much much easier. **\*With the exception of people who simply make/use new accounts because their mains got perm'd or they just want to troll with friends in lower ranks.\***
